 784    }

 791void DocMarkdownWriter::writeExtensionConditions(
 792    StringBuilder& out,
 793    ExtensionDecl* extensionDecl,
 794    const char* prefix,
 795    bool isHtml)
 0796{
 797    // Synthesize `where` clause for things defined in an extension.
 0798    auto targetTypeDeclRef = isDeclRefTypeOf<ContainerDecl>(extensionDecl->targetType);
 0799    if (!targetTypeDeclRef)
 800        return;
 801
 0802    if (auto genAppDeclRef = as<GenericAppDeclRef>(targetTypeDeclRef.declRefBase))
 803    {
 0804        for (Index i = 0; i < genAppDeclRef->getArgCount(); i++)
 805        {
 0806            auto arg = genAppDeclRef->getArg(i);
 0807            Decl* genericParamDecl = nullptr;
 808            Index parameterIndex = i;
 0809            if (auto extTypeParamDecl = isDeclRefTypeOf<GenericTypeParamDeclBase>(arg))
 810            {
 0811                genericParamDecl = extTypeParamDecl.getDecl();
 0812            }
 0813            else if (auto extValueParamVal = as<DeclRefIntVal>(arg))
 814            {
 0815                genericParamDecl = extValueParamVal->getDeclRef().getDecl();
 816            }
 817
 818            // Locate the original generic parameter defined on the type being extended.
 819            Decl* originalParamDecl = nullptr;
 0820            if (auto targetTypeParentGenericDecl =
 821                    as<GenericDecl>(targetTypeDeclRef.getDecl()->parentDecl))
 822            {
 0823                for (auto member : targetTypeParentGenericDecl->getDirectMemberDecls())
 824                {
 0825                    if (auto typeParamDecl = as<GenericTypeParamDeclBase>(member))
 826                    {
 0827                        if (typeParamDecl->parameterIndex == parameterIndex)
 828                        {
 829                            originalParamDecl = typeParamDecl;
 830                            break;
 831                        }
 0832                    }
 0833                    else if (auto valParamDecl = as<GenericValueParamDecl>(member))
 834                    {
 835                        if (valParamDecl->parameterIndex == parameterIndex)
 836                        {
 837                            originalParamDecl = valParamDecl;
 838                            break;
 839                        }
 840                    }
 0841                    else if (auto valPackParamDecl = as<GenericValuePackParamDecl>(member))
 842                    {
 843                        if (valPackParamDecl->parameterIndex == parameterIndex)
 844                        {
 845                            originalParamDecl = valPackParamDecl;
 846                            break;
 847                        }
 848                    }
 849                }
 850            }
 851
 852            // If we can't find such parameter, bail.
 853            if (!originalParamDecl)
 854                continue;
 855
 0856            bool isEqualityConstraint = false;
 0857            Val* constraintVal = nullptr;
 0858            if (genericParamDecl)
 859            {
 860                // If we have `TargetType<T>` the member belongs to `extension<X : C>
 861                // TargetType<X>`, We want to print a synthesized `where T : C` clause. Here
 862                // `extTypeParamDecl` is a reference to `X`, so we need to find the corresponding
 863                // `T`.
 864
 865                // Find constraints on the originalParamDecl.
 866                for (auto typeConstraint :
 867                     genericParamDecl->parentDecl
 0868                         ->getDirectMemberDeclsOfType<GenericTypeConstraintDecl>())
 869                {
 0870                    if (isDeclRefTypeOf<Decl>(typeConstraint->sub.type).getDecl() ==
 871                        genericParamDecl)
 872                    {
 0873                        if (typeConstraint->isEqualityConstraint)
 874                        {
 875                            isEqualityConstraint = true;
 876                        }
 0877                        constraintVal = typeConstraint->getSup().type;
 878                        break;
 879                    }
 880                }
 0881            }
 882            else
 883            {
 884                // If we have `extension TargetType<Y>` where `Y` does not name a generic parameter
 885                // defined on the extension itself, we want to print a synthesized `where T == Y`
 886                // clause, where `T` is the original generic parameter on the target type.
 0887                isEqualityConstraint = true;
 0888                constraintVal = arg;
 889            }
 0890            if (constraintVal)
 891            {
 0892                out << prefix;
 0893                if (isHtml)
 0894                    out << translateToHTMLWithLinks(
 895                        originalParamDecl,
 896                        originalParamDecl->getName()->text);
 897                else
 0898                    out << translateToMarkdownWithLinks(originalParamDecl->getName()->text);
 899                if (isEqualityConstraint)
 900                    out << " == ";
 901                else
 902                    out << " : ";
 903                if (isHtml)
 0904                    out << translateToHTMLWithLinks(originalParamDecl, constraintVal->toString());
 905                else
 0906                    out << translateToMarkdownWithLinks(constraintVal->toString());
 907            }
 908        }
 909    }
 0910}

 912void DocMarkdownWriter::writeSignature(CallableDecl* callableDecl)
 0913{
 0914    StringBuilder& out = *getBuilder(callableDecl);
 915
 0916    if (callableDecl->hasModifier<HLSLStaticModifier>())
 917    {
 0918        out << "<span class='code_keyword'>static</span> ";
 919    }
 920
 0921    auto declRef = makeDeclRef(callableDecl);
 922
 0923    if (hasDirectFuncType(declRef.as<CallableDecl>()))
 924    {
 925        // For declarations whose type is expressed as a single func-type expression
 926        // (e.g. autodiff synthesized functions like fwd_diff, bwd_diff), print as
 927        //   name : <func-type>
 928        // since the func-type may not decompose into a simple return + params form.
 0929        ASTPrinter namePrinter(
 930            m_astBuilder,
 931            ASTPrinter::OptionFlag::ParamNames |
 932                ASTPrinter::OptionFlag::NoSpecializedExtensionTypeName);
 0933        namePrinter.addDeclPath(declRef);
 0934        out << translateToHTMLWithLinks(callableDecl, namePrinter.getSlice());
 935
 0936        auto substituted = declRef.substitute(m_astBuilder, callableDecl->funcType.type);
 0937        auto resolved = substituted ? substituted->resolve() : nullptr;
 938
 0939        ASTPrinter typePrinter(
 940            m_astBuilder,
 941            ASTPrinter::OptionFlag::ParamNames |
 942                ASTPrinter::OptionFlag::NoSpecializedExtensionTypeName);
 0943        typePrinter.addType(as<Type>(resolved));
 944
 0945        out << toSlice(" : ") << translateToHTMLWithLinks(callableDecl, typePrinter.getSlice());
 0946        return;
 947    }
 948
 0949    List<ASTPrinter::Part> parts;
 950
 0951    ASTPrinter printer(
 952        m_astBuilder,
 953        ASTPrinter::OptionFlag::ParamNames | ASTPrinter::OptionFlag::NoSpecializedExtensionTypeName,
 954        &parts);
 0955    printer.addDeclSignature(declRef);
 956
 0957    Signature signature;
 0958    getSignature(parts, signature);
 959
 0960    const Index paramCount = signature.params.getCount();
 961
 962    {
 963        // Some types (like constructors say) don't have any return type, so check before outputting
 0964        const UnownedStringSlice returnType = printer.getPartSlice(signature.returnType);
 0965        if (returnType.getLength() > 0)
 966        {
 0967            out << translateToHTMLWithLinks(callableDecl, returnType) << toSlice(" ");
 968        }
 969    }
 970
 0971    out << translateToHTMLWithLinks(callableDecl, printer.getPartSlice(signature.name));
 972
 0973    switch (paramCount)
 974    {
 975    case 0:
 976        {
 977            // Has no parameters
 0978            out << toSlice("()");
 979            break;
 980        }
 981    case 1:
 982        {
 0983            if (signature.name.end - signature.name.start < 40)
 984            {
 985                // Place all on single line
 0986                out.appendChar('(');
 0987                const auto& param = signature.params[0];
 0988                out << translateToHTMLWithLinks(callableDecl, printer.getPartSlice(param.first))
 989                    << toSlice(" ");
 0990                out << translateToHTMLWithLinks(callableDecl, printer.getPartSlice(param.second));
 0991                out << ")";
 0992                break;
 993            }
 994            // If the name is already long, fall through to default.
 995            [[fallthrough]];
 996        }
 997    default:
 998        {
 999            // Put each parameter on a line on it's own
 01000            out << toSlice("(\n");
 01001            StringBuilder line;
 01002            for (Index i = 0; i < paramCount; ++i)
 1003            {
 01004                const auto& param = signature.params[i];
 01005                line.clear();
 1006
 01007                line << "    "
 1008                     << translateToHTMLWithLinks(callableDecl, printer.getPartSlice(param.first));
 1009
 01010                line.appendChar(' ');
 01011                line << translateToHTMLWithLinks(callableDecl, printer.getPartSlice(param.second));
 01012                if (i < paramCount - 1)
 1013                {
 01014                    line << ",\n";
 1015                }
 1016
 01017                out << line;
 1018            }
 1019
 01020            out << ")";
 01021            break;
 1022        }
 1023    }
 1024
 1025    // Print `where` clause.
 1026    Decl* parentDecl = callableDecl;
 01027    while (parentDecl)
 1028    {
 01029        if (auto extensionDecl = as<ExtensionDecl>(parentDecl))
 1030        {
 1031            // Synthesize `where` clause for things defined in an extension.
 01032            if (auto targetTypeDeclRef = isDeclRefTypeOf<ContainerDecl>(extensionDecl->targetType))
 1033            {
 01034                writeExtensionConditions(
 1035                    out,
 1036                    extensionDecl,
 1037                    "\n    <span class='code_keyword'>where</span> ",
 1038                    true);
 1039                // We need to follow the parent of the target type instead of the parent of the
 1040                // extension decl.
 01041                parentDecl = getParentDecl(targetTypeDeclRef.getDecl());
 01042                continue;
 1043            }
 1044        }
 1045
 01046        if (auto genericParent = as<GenericDecl>(parentDecl->parentDecl))
 1047        {
 1048            for (auto typeConstraint :
 01049                 genericParent->getDirectMemberDeclsOfType<GenericTypeConstraintDecl>())
 1050            {
 01051                out << toSlice("\n    <span class='code_keyword'>where</span> ");
 01052                out << translateToHTMLWithLinks(
 1053                    parentDecl,
 1054                    getSub(m_astBuilder, typeConstraint)->toString());
 01055                if (typeConstraint->isEqualityConstraint)
 01056                    out << " == ";
 1057                else

 01059                out << translateToHTMLWithLinks(
 1060                    parentDecl,
 1061                    getSup(m_astBuilder, typeConstraint)->toString());
 1062            }
 1063        }
 1064        parentDecl = getParentDecl(parentDecl);
 1065    }
 01066    out << ";\n";

 1774void DocMarkdownWriter::_appendEscaped(const UnownedStringSlice& text)
 01775{
 01776    auto& out = *m_builder;
 1777
 01778    const char* start = text.begin();
 1779    const char* cur = start;
 01780    const char* const end = text.end();
 1781
 01782    for (; cur < end; ++cur)
 1783    {
 01784        const char c = *cur;
 1785
 01786        switch (c)
 1787        {
 1788        case '<':
 1789        case '>':
 1790        case '&':
 1791        case '"':
 1792        case '_':
 1793            {
 1794                // Flush if any before
 01795                if (cur > start)
 1796                {
 01797                    out.append(start, cur);
 1798                }
 1799                // Prefix with the
 01800                out.appendChar('\\');
 1801
 1802                // Start will still include the char, for later flushing
 01803                start = cur;
 1804                break;
 1805            }
 1806        default:
 1807            break;
 1808        }
 1809    }
 1810
 1811    // Flush any remaining
 01812    if (cur > start)
 1813    {
 01814        out.append(start, cur);
 1815    }
 01816}

 2089String DocMarkdownWriter::escapeMarkdownText(String text)
 02090{
 02091    StringBuilder sb;
 02092    for (auto c : text)
 2093    {
 02094        switch (c)
 2095        {
 2096        case '_':
 2097        case '*':
 2098        case '[':
 2099        case ']':
 2100        case '<':
 2101        case '>':
 2102        case '|':
 2103        case '.':
 2104        case '!':
 2105        case '(':
 2106        case ')':
 02107            sb << '\\';
 2108            sb.appendChar(c);
 2109            break;
 2110        default:
 2111            sb.appendChar(c);
 2112            break;
 2113        }
 2114    }
 02115    return sb.produceString();
 02116}

 2629bool DocMarkdownWriter::isVisible(const ASTMarkup::Entry& entry)

 2640
 2641bool DocMarkdownWriter::isVisible(Decl* decl)
 02642{
 02643    if (!isVisible(decl->getName()))
 2644    {
 2645        return false;
 2646    }
 2647    bool parentIsVisible = true;
 02648    auto parent = decl;
 02649    while (parent)
 2650    {
 02651        if (auto extDecl = as<ExtensionDecl>(parent))
 2652        {
 02653            if (auto targetDecl = isDeclRefTypeOf<Decl>(extDecl->targetType))
 2654            {
 02655                parentIsVisible = parentIsVisible && isVisible(targetDecl.getDecl());
 02656                parent = targetDecl.getDecl();
 02657            }
 2658            else
 2659            {
 2660                parent = getParentDecl(parent);
 2661            }
 2662        }
 2663        else
 2664        {
 2665            parent = getParentDecl(parent);
 2666        }
 02667        if (as<AggTypeDeclBase>(parent))
 2668        {
 02669            parentIsVisible = parentIsVisible && isVisible(parent);
 2670        }
 2671    }
 02672    auto entry = m_markup->getEntry(decl);
 02673    return parentIsVisible && (entry == nullptr || entry->m_visibility == MarkupVisibility::Public);
 02674}

 2676void DocumentationConfig::parse(UnownedStringSlice config)
 02677{
 02678    List<UnownedStringSlice> lines;
 02679    StringUtil::calcLines(config, lines);
 02680    Index ptr = 0;
 02681    for (; ptr < lines.getCount(); ptr++)
 2682    {
 02683        auto line = lines[ptr];
 02684        if (line.startsWith(toSlice("@preamble:")))
 2685        {
 02686            ptr++;
 02687            StringBuilder preambleSB;
 02688            for (; ptr < lines.getCount(); ptr++)
 2689            {
 02690                if (lines[ptr].startsWith("@end"))
 2691                    break;
 02692                preambleSB << lines[ptr] << "\n";
 2693            }
 02694            ptr++;
 02695            preamble = preambleSB.produceString();
 02696        }
 02697        else if (line.startsWith(toSlice("@title:")))
 2698        {
 02699            title = line.tail(7).trim();
 02700        }
 02701        else if (line.startsWith(toSlice("@libname:")))
 2702        {
 02703            libName = line.tail(9).trim();
 02704        }
 02705        else if (line.startsWith(toSlice("@rootdir:")))
 2706        {
 02707            rootDir = line.tail(9).trim();
 02708        }
 02709        else if (line.startsWith("@includedecl:"))
 2710        {
 02711            ptr++;
 02712            for (; ptr < lines.getCount(); ptr++)
 2713            {
 02714                if (lines[ptr].startsWith("@end"))
 2715                    break;
 02716                auto name = lines[ptr].trim();
 02717                if (name.getLength())
 02718                    visibleDeclNames.add(name);
 2719            }
 02720            ptr++;
 2721        }
 2722    }
 02723}

 2751DocumentPage* DocMarkdownWriter::writeAll(UnownedStringSlice configStr)

 2754
 02755    auto addBuiltinPage = [&](DocumentPage* parent,
 2756                              UnownedStringSlice path,

 02772    m_rootPage = addBuiltinPage(

 02779    m_interfacesPage = addBuiltinPage(

 02789    m_attributesPage = addBuiltinPage(

 2799
 2800    // In the first pass, we create all the pages so we can reference them
 2801    // when writing the content.
 02802    for (auto& entry : m_markup->getEntries())
 2803    {
 02804        Decl* decl = as<Decl>(entry.m_node);
 2805
 02806        if (decl && isVisible(entry))
 2807        {
 02808            createPage(entry, decl);
 2809        }
 2810    }
 2811    // In the second pass, actually writes the content to each page.
 02812    writePageRecursive(m_rootPage.get());
 2813
 02814    generateSectionIndexPage(m_interfacesPage);

 2818

 2822void DocMarkdownWriter::writePage(DocumentPage* page)
 02823{
 02824    if (page->skipWrite)
 2825        return;
 02826    if (page->entries.getCount() == 0)
 2827        return;
 2828
 2829    m_currentPage = page;

 02832    writePreamble();

 02834    Decl* decl = (Decl*)page->getFirstEntry()->m_node;
 02835    if (CallableDecl* callableDecl = as<CallableDecl>(decl))
 2836    {

 02838    }
 02839    else if (EnumDecl* enumDecl = as<EnumDecl>(decl))
 2840    {
 02841        writeEnum(*page->getFirstEntry(), enumDecl);
 02842    }
 02843    else if (AggTypeDeclBase* aggTypeDeclBase = as<AggTypeDeclBase>(decl))
 2844    {
 2845        // Find the primary decl.
 02846        ASTMarkup::Entry* primaryEntry = page->getFirstEntry();
 2847        AggTypeDeclBase* primaryDecl = aggTypeDeclBase;
 02848        for (auto entry : page->entries)
 2849        {
 02850            if (auto aggTypeDecl = as<AggTypeDecl>(entry->m_node))
 2851            {
 02852                primaryEntry = entry;
 02853                primaryDecl = aggTypeDecl;
 2854                break;
 2855            }
 2856        }
 02857        writeAggType(page, *primaryEntry, primaryDecl);
 02858    }
 02859    else if (PropertyDecl* propertyDecl = as<PropertyDecl>(decl))
 2860    {
 02861        writeProperty(*page->getFirstEntry(), propertyDecl);
 02862    }
 02863    else if (VarDecl* varDecl = as<VarDecl>(decl))
 2864    {
 02865        writeVar(*page->getFirstEntry(), varDecl);
 02866    }
 02867    else if (TypeDefDecl* typeDefDecl = as<TypeDefDecl>(decl))
 2868    {
 02869        writeTypeDef(*page->getFirstEntry(), typeDefDecl);
 02870    }
 02871    else if (AttributeDecl* attributeDecl = as<AttributeDecl>(decl))
 2872    {
 02873        writeAttribute(*page->getFirstEntry(), attributeDecl);
 2874    }
 02875}

 2877void DocMarkdownWriter::writePageRecursive(DocumentPage* page)

 2947    }
 2948
 02949    for (auto& cat : categoryNames)

 2981                << ")\n\n";
 2982        }
 2983
 2984        // Add the toctree for the category landing page.
 02985        landingPage->contentSB << "\n<!-- RTD-TOC-START\n";
 02986        landingPage->contentSB << "```{toctree}\n:titlesonly:\n:hidden:\n\n";
 02987        for (auto child : categories[cat])
 2988        {
 02989            landingPage->contentSB << getTocTreeEntry(child->shortName, parentPath, child->path);
 2990        }
 02991        landingPage->contentSB << "```\n";

 2993
 02994        page->children.add(landingPage);
 02995    }
 2996
 02997    for (auto child : categories[""])
 2998    {
 02999        writeTOCImpl(sb, writer, config, child);
 3000    }
 03001    sb << "</ul>\n";

 3090struct DocumentationStats
 3091{
 3092    int documentedPageCount = 0;
 3093    List<String> undocumentedPages;
 3094};
 3095
 3096static void _collectStats(DocumentationStats& stats, DocumentPage* page)
 03097{
 03098    if (!page->skipWrite && page->entries.getCount() != 0)
 3099    {
 3100        bool isDocumented = false;
 03101        for (auto entry : page->entries)
 3102        {
 03103            if (entry->m_markup.getUnownedSlice().trim().getLength() > 0)
 3104            {
 03105                DeclDocumentation doc;
 03106                doc.parse(entry->m_markup.getUnownedSlice());
 03107                auto desc = doc.sections.tryGetValue(DocPageSection::Description);
 3108                // A page is considered documented if it has a description section
 3109                // with more than 10 characters and ends with a `.`.
 03110                if (desc && desc->ownedText.trim().getLength() > 10 &&
 3111                    String(desc->ownedText.trim()).endsWith("."))
 3112                {
 3113                    isDocumented = true;
 3114                }
 03115                break;
 3116            }
 3117        }
 03118        if (isDocumented)
 3119        {
 03120            stats.documentedPageCount++;
 03121        }
 3122        else
 3123        {
 03124            stats.undocumentedPages.add(page->title);
 3125        }
 3126    }
 03127    for (auto child : page->children)
 3128    {
 03129        _collectStats(stats, child);
 03130    }
 03131}

 3133void DocumentPage::writeSummary(UnownedStringSlice fileName)
